name: bbb-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server exposing Brisbane Bowser Beater's public fuel-price forecast data

scripts.build: esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
